Align Weapon (Devil Law2 Tran): Touched weapon gains a choice of chaotic, evil, good, or lawful alignment (save Will negates) for 20 min
Bless (Family1 Ench): Allies within 50' gain +1 attacks and fear saves for 20 min
Calm Emotions (Family2 Ench): R300' Pacifies creatures in a 20' radius (save Will negates), negating rage and morale bonuses, for concentration up to 20 rd or until any target is attacked
Command (Devil Law1 Ench): R75' Target obeys a command to approach, drop, fall, flee, or halt (save Will negates) for 1 rd
Create Food And Water (Family3 Conj): R75' Creates enough food and water to sustain 60 humans or 20 horses for 24 hr; the food remains edible for 24 hr
Dictum (Devil Law7 Evoc): Inflicts on nonlawful creatures within 40' a set of effects: banishment for 24 hr (save Will -4 negates) on extraplanar creatures; killed or destroyed on creatures with up to 10 HD (save will inflicts 3d6+20 HP); paralyzed for 1d10 min on creatures with up to 15 HD (save Will inflicts paralyzed for 1 rd); staggered for 2d4 rd on creatures with up to 19 HD (save Will inflicts staggered for 1d4 rd); deafened for 1d4 rd on creatures with up to 20 HD (save Will negates)
Dispel Chaos (Devil Law5 Abju): Gives self a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class vs. chaotic creatures for 20 rd; can end the spell early with a touch that dismisses a chaotic creature (save Will negates), a chaotic spell, or a spell cast by a chaotic caster
Heroes' Feast (Family6 Conj): R75' Creates food for 20 creatures that cures sickness, poison, and disease, gives 1d8+10 temporary hit points, +1 attacks, +1 Will saves, and +4 saves vs. poison and fear, for 12 hr
Imbue With Spell Ability (Family4 Evoc): Touched with an Intelligence of at least 5, Wisdom of at least 9, and 1, 3, or 5 HD gains the ability to cast chosen 1st, 2x1st, or 2x1st+2nd level spells from self prepared abjuration, divination, or healing spells; the Imbue With Spell Ability spell slot cannot be recovered until these spells are cast or dismissed
Mass Cure Critical Wounds (Family8 Conj): R75' 20 targets in a 15' radius regain 4d8+20 hit points; undead instead suffer the same amount (save Will half)
Miracle (Family9 Evoc): Requests deity intercession to duplicate the effects of a cleric spell of up to 8th level, duplicate the effects of other spells up to 7th level, undo the harmful affects of spells, or create effects of similar power; more powerful effects cost 25,000 GP to request
Order's Wrath (Devil Law4 Evoc): R300' Chaotic creatures in a 30' cube suffer 5d8 HP (or 10d6 HP to outsiders) and are dazed for 1 rd (save Will half HP only); neutral creatures suffer half HP only (save Will half)
Planar Binding (Devil Law6 Conj): Traps 1-3 extraplanar creatures with up to 12 HD total in a Magic Circle (save Will negates) until they perform a task (opposed Charisma allows refusal), or escape via SR, dimensional travel, or a DC 27 Charisma check
Refuge (Family7 Conj): Breaking a prepared object and speaking a command word transports the possessor to self home or transports self to possessor
Shield Of Law (Devil Law8 Abju): 20 creatures within 20' gain a +4 deflection bonus to Armor Class, +4 saves, SR 25 vs. chaotic spells and casters, an additional +2 save to suppress existing mental control and possession, and immunity to new attempts to control or possess, and slow successful chaotic attackers (save Will negates) for 20 rd
Suggestion (Devil Law3 Ench): R75' Target follows a reasonable suggestion (save Will negates) for up to 20 hr
Summon Monster IX (Devil Law9 Conj): R75' Summons 1 9th-level, 1d3 8th-level, or 1d4+1 lower-level creatures that fight foes and obey orders for 20 rd
Telepathic Bond (Family5 Divi): R75' Allows self and/or 6 willing targets in a 15' radius with at least 3 Intelligence to share thoughts for 200 min
